description: Command: the core's automation starts or cancels an automatic art job (Hub #679, #684). The envelope subject is `art`. Only `bunny/core` may send it: the gateway refuses it from any client and the tracker checks `requestedBy`. The art module applies the automatic limits to every job this family admits, even one whose `origin` or `purpose` says otherwise, and may cancel only automatic jobs with it. It has `art-request`'s start and cancel without typed text. The validator refuses `variationOf` without the purpose `variation` or the reverse (art.ts).
